$schema.title: JSON Schema
$schema.description: JSON Schema URI used by editors for completion and validation.

excludePackages.title: Excluded packages
excludePackages.description: Package ID patterns to never update. Supports * as a wildcard.

allowedLicenses.title: Allowed licenses
allowedLicenses.description: Only update to versions whose license expression contains one of these values. Packages without license metadata are always allowed.

path.title: Default target path
path.description: Relative path to a solution, project, or directory to update when no target is supplied on the command line. Resolved relative to this file.

excludeFiles.title: Excluded files
excludeFiles.description: File path patterns to never update, relative to the resolved target. Supports * as a wildcard.

alignWithTfm.title: Align with target framework
alignWithTfm.description: Package ID patterns whose major version is capped at the project's target framework major version. Supports * as a wildcard.

toolPackagePins.title: Tool package pins
toolPackagePins.description: Rules that keep a .NET tool compatible with a package used by the affected project.

tool.title: .NET tool package ID
tool.description: Package ID of the .NET tool to constrain.

package.title: Referenced package ID pattern
package.description: Package ID pattern matched against package references in the affected project. Supports * as a wildcard.

packagePolicies.title: Package version policies
packagePolicies.description: Rules that cap matching packages at a fixed major version.

package.title: Package ID pattern
package.description: Package ID pattern to cap. Supports * as a wildcard.

maxMajor.title: Maximum major version
maxMajor.description: Highest major version UpdatR may install for this package.

failOn.title: Failure severity
failOn.description: Exit with code 2 when a finding at or above this severity is found.

failOnIncomplete.title: Fail on incomplete checks
failOnIncomplete.description: Exit with code 2 when a package source is unauthorized or a package cannot be resolved from any source.
